channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Over 50 decomposing bodies discovered at Far South Side funeral home
item.description: An investigation is underway at a Far South Side funeral home after more than 50 decomposing bodies were found on the premises.

item.title: Thailand school shooting leaves at least six dead after suspect kills grandparents
item.description: A teenager reportedly described as troubled by a classmate killed his grandparents before shooting at least six others at a school in Thailand.

item.title: Fan sues New York Yankees for $10 million after bat strike to head
item.description: A fan is suing the Yankees, alleging permanent injuries from being hit by a bat that flew into the stands.

item.title: Golf cart arson in Washington state caught on camera
item.description: A witness said the suspect claimed to be with the fire department.
